The commit does not make use of the API, it is just providing a getter to get the map? The statement is mis-leading, could you please fix that.
Nit: In this commit ConfigManager exposes ?
consumer of this API is missing ?
can we say, Trigger multi-threaded VPD collection for all Chassis Motherboard ?
can we use chassis instead, collectAllchassisVpd ?
The commit message doesn't explain why this change is needed.
I don't see a use case where this API should have a bool return type.
Exception details missing from the doxygen of this API.

How are you calling a private API in another class?

This call will be wrapped in thread manager's public API which will be called by manager to collect all FRU vpd.
So this call shouldn't be here.
No use case of return value as of now. Will add if required. For now it should be void.

Why is this being called in the constructor just after the creating of thread manager?
Collection needs to be triggered only when requested. This call will replace the existing flow so should be there?
Removed from here , now this call is being triggered in collectallfruvpd api.
